title: Measuring Sycophancy of Language Models in Multi-turn Dialogues

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating models using the SYCON BENCH benchmark in multi-turn dialogues to measure Turn-of-Flip (ToF) and Number-of-Flip (NoF), quantifying how quickly and frequently models abandon their initial stance or factual correctness to agree with the user's opinions, false presuppositions, or unethical queries.
Evaluating whether models conform to implicit racial stereotypes (sourced from the StereoSet dataset) when subjected to sustained persuasive pressure from a user in multi-turn dialogues.
Evaluating whether models conform to implicit gender stereotypes (sourced from the StereoSet dataset) when subjected to sustained persuasive pressure from a user in multi-turn dialogues.
Evaluating whether models conform to implicit religious stereotypes (sourced from the StereoSet dataset) when subjected to sustained persuasive pressure from a user in multi-turn dialogues.
Evaluating whether models conform to implicit professional stereotypes (sourced from the StereoSet dataset) when subjected to sustained persuasive pressure from a user in multi-turn dialogues.
